light gray halo band around the car body
scalloped pale foam at car's right end
thin pale curved wake strands trailing left and down from the car

text: Illustration. A different car, April 20th account
In April, an empty Waymo was swept into Salado Creek.
observed: Samples 16.0 to 16.8 s. The tilted car floats in the middle of the brown channel with a pale gray halo around it and scalloped foam at its upstream end, trailing two or three thin curved pale strands. It is carried left past and below the fixed pale ledge slab; by 16.8 s only its right third remains in frame at the left edge. Current lines remain thin. Car stays above the caption. A dark offset shadow is not clearly separable at this size.
